paper.abstract_en: According to the Festina Lente bound, particles charged under a $U(1)$ gauge field cannot be too light. Otherwise, the largest charged black holes of de Sitter space would discharge in a way that leads to a crunching singularity in violation of cosmic censorship. The Festina Lente bound has previously been extended to also include a background of thermal radiation, but where vacuum energy still dominates cosmic evolution, which imposes a maximal temperature $T\leq T_{\max}=(cV/σ)^{1/4}$. We extend this analysis by accounting for thermal enhancement of the discharge process and making the analysis more quantitative. The result is a bound $m\gtrsim\ell (cV/σ)^{1/4}$ on the masses of charged particles. Here, $\ell$ is a term that depends logarithmically on the gauge coupling and particle charge. At weak coupling this leads to a significantly stronger constraint than the $\sqrt{gq}$ scaling of the original Festina Lente bound. As a result, the present vacuum energy requires every particle of charge $10^{-26}\lesssim gq\lesssim e$ to be heavier than $0.03$--$0.2$ eV, provided its gauge boson is lighter than the Hubble scale. An unbroken gauged $B-L$ with Dirac neutrinos gives $m_{ν,{\rm lightest}}\gtrsim10$--$43$ meV for $10^{-29}\lesssim g_{B-L}\lesssim10^{-24}$, in tension with the DESI DR2 limit once $g_{B-L}\gtrsim7\times10^{-28}$. The same limit bounds a neutrino millicharge to $ε_ν\lesssim2\times10^{-27}$. We also revisit the Standard Model effective field theory constraints from the electroweak phase transition. During slow-roll inflation the Standard Model electron violates the bound over the whole range of Hubble rates allowed by the CMB tensor limit and by nucleosynthesis, unless the photon is Higgsed, its coupling is suppressed, or one considers very fine-tuned versions of Higgs inflation.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该工作将 Festina Lente 界推广到包含热辐射背景的情形，定量计算了热增强的放电过程，并给出对带电粒子质量、B-L 规范耦合、中微子毫电荷以及电弱相变和暴胀期间的标准模型有效场论约束的新限制，理论深度和可检验性强，值得深入阅读。
decision.abstract_zh: 根据 Festina Lente 界，携带 $U(1)$ 规范场荷的粒子不能过轻。否则，de Sitter 空间中最大的带电黑洞会以导致挤压奇点的方式放电，从而违反宇宙监督。此前 Festina Lente 界已被推广到同时包含热辐射背景的情形，但要求真空能仍主导宇宙演化，这给出最高温度 $T\leq T_{\max}=(cV/σ)^{1/4}$。我们通过考虑放电过程的热增强并使分析更加定量化来扩展这一分析。结果是带电粒子质量上的一个界 $m\gtrsim\ell (cV/σ)^{1/4}$。这里，$\ell$ 是一个对数依赖于规范耦合和粒子电荷的项。在弱耦合下，这导致比原始 Festina Lente 界的 $\sqrt{gq}$ 标度显著更强的约束。因此，当前的真空能要求每个电荷为 $10^{-26}\lesssim gq\lesssim e$ 的粒子必须重于 $0.03$--$0.2$ eV，前提是其规范玻色子轻于哈勃尺度。一个带有 Dirac 中微子的未破缺规范 $B-L$ 给出 $m_{\nu,{\rm lightest}}\gtrsim10$--$43$ meV（对 $10^{-29}\lesssim g_{B-L}\lesssim10^{-24}$），一旦 $g_{B-L}\gtrsim7\times10^{-28}$ 便与 DESI DR2 限制相冲突。同一限制将中微子毫电荷约束为 $ε_ν\lesssim2\times10^{-27}$。我们还重新审视了来自电弱相变的标准模型有效场论约束。在慢滚暴胀期间，标准模型电子在整个由 CMB 张量限制和核合成所允许的哈勃率范围内违反该界，除非光子被 Higgs 化、其耦合被压低，或者考虑高度微调版本的 Higgs 暴胀。
